description: This file defines a SharedService class for managing shared worker communication, message channels, and provider-client coordination within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for activation, deactivation, message handling, and proxy creation, utilizing Web Locks, BroadcastChannel, and MessagePort.

classes.name: SharedService
classes.description: A class managing shared worker communication, provider-client coordination, message passing, and proxying for a shared service.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SharedService instance, sets up message event listeners, and creates a proxy.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the service as a provider, acquiring a lock, setting up message channels, and handling client requests.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Aborts the current provider activation, releasing resources.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the service, rejecting pending callbacks and deactivating.

methods.name: #sendPortToClient
methods.description: Sends a message with a MessagePort to the client, via shared worker or service worker.

methods.name: #getClientId
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a unique client ID, coordinating via Web Locks and service worker.

methods.name: #providerChange
methods.description: Handles provider transition by requesting a MessagePort and setting up message handlers.

methods.name: #resendPendingCallbacks
methods.description: Resends queued callbacks to the current provider port.

methods.name: #createProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy object to facilitate method calls over message channels.

methods.name: getProviderPort
methods.description: Ensures a valid provider port is available for communication.
